he.text: וַיַּעֲבוֹר יְיָ עַל־פָּנָיו וַיִּקְרָא׃ יְיָ יְיָ · אֵל · רַחוּם · וְחַנּוּן · אֶרֶךְ־אַפַּיִם · וְרַב־חֶסֶד · וֶאֱמֶת׃ נֹצֵר חֶסֶד לָאֲלָפִים · נֹשֵׂא עָוֹן וָפֶשַׁע · וְחַטָּאָה · וְנַקֵּה׃ וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֹנֵנוּ וּלְחַטָּאתֵנוּ וּנְחַלְתָּנוּ׃ סְלַח־לָנוּ אָבִינוּ כִּי־חָטָאנוּ מְחַל־לָנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כִּי־פָשָׁעְנוּ׃ כִּי־אַתָּה יְיָ טוֹב וְסַלָּח וְרַב־חֶסֶד לְכָל־קֹרְאֶיךָ׃

en.text: “And the Eternal passed by before him (Moses) and proclaimed: The Eternal is the immutable eternal being; an omnipotent God, merciful and gracious, long-suffering, and abundant in beneficence and truth; keeping mercy unto thousands, forgiving iniquity, transgression, and sin, and acquitting. Pardon thou our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thy heritage. Forgive us, O our Father! for we have sinned: pardon us, O our King! for we have transgressed. For thou, O Lord! art good, and ready to pardon, and of abundant mercy unto all those who call on thee.”
